data.name: Painful Smite
data.description: Prior to making a melee attack roll, you can choose to convert all damage from that strike into nonlethal damage, adding +%1 to the damage. If you succeed in your attack, as a free action you can make an Intimidate check against your target to demoralize the target. You gain a bonus on your Intimidate check equal to the amount of nonlethal damage dealt by the painful smite. You can use this ability %2 times per day.|WIS|DomainDestructionTimes
